```{r}
library(tidyverse) 
library(infer) 
library(randomForest) 
library(tidymodels) 
library(modelr) 
library(yardstick)

load('data/biomarker-clean.RData') View(biomarker_clean)
```

### Question 3, Part a
Choose training/testing split at the beginning

```{r}
# Split the data into 80% training and 20% testing immediately
set.seed(101422)
biomarker_split <- biomarker_clean %>%
  initial_split(prop = 0.8)

# Extract training and testing sets
train_data <- training(biomarker_split)
test_data  <- testing(biomarker_split)

# MULTIPLE TESTING (only on training)
# function to compute tests
test_fn <- function(.df){
  t_test(.df, 
         formula = level ~ group,
         order = c('ASD', 'TD'),
         alternative = 'two-sided',
         var.equal = F)
}

ttests_out <- train_data %>%
  # drop ADOS score
  select(-ados) %>%
  # arrange in long format
  pivot_longer(-group, 
               names_to = 'protein', 
               values_to = 'level') %>%
  # nest by protein
  nest(data = c(level, group)) %>% 
  # compute t tests
  mutate(ttest = map(data, test_fn)) %>%
  unnest(ttest) %>%
  # sort by p-value
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  # multiple testing correction
  mutate(m = n(),
         hm = log(m) + 1/(2*m) - digamma(1),
         rank = row_number(),
         p.adj = m*hm*p_value/rank)

# select significant proteins
proteins_s1 <- ttests_out %>%
  slice_min(p.adj, n = 10) %>%
  pull(protein)


# RANDOM FOREST (only on training)

# store predictors and response separately using train_data
predictors <- train_data %>%
  select(-c(group, ados))

response <- train_data %>% pull(group) %>% factor()

# fit RF
set.seed(101422)
rf_out <- randomForest(x = predictors, 
                       y = response, 
                       ntree = 1000, 
                       importance = T)

# compute importance scores
proteins_s2 <- rf_out$importance %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(protein = rownames(rf_out$importance)) %>%
  slice_max(MeanDecreaseGini, n = 10) %>%
  pull(protein)

# LOGISTIC REG & EVAL
# Find the overlapping proteins selected using training data only
proteins_sstar <- intersect(proteins_s1, proteins_s2)

# Prepare training data
biomarker_sstar_train <- train_data %>%
  select(group, any_of(proteins_sstar)) %>%
  mutate(class = factor(group == "ASD",
                        levels = c(FALSE, TRUE))) %>%
  select(-group)

# Fit logistic regression model
fit <- glm(
  class ~ .,
  data = biomarker_sstar_train,
  family = binomial()
)

# Define metrics
class_metrics <- metric_set(
  sensitivity,
  specificity,
  accuracy,
  roc_auc
)

# Prepare testing data
biomarker_sstar_test <- test_data %>%
  select(group, any_of(proteins_sstar)) %>%
  mutate(class = factor(group == "ASD",
                        levels = c(FALSE, TRUE))) %>%
  select(-group)

# Generate predicted probabilities
biomarker_sstar_test <- biomarker_sstar_test %>%
  mutate(
    pred = predict(fit,
                   newdata = biomarker_sstar_test,
                   type = "response")
  )

# Convert predicted probabilities into class predictions
biomarker_sstar_test <- biomarker_sstar_test %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = factor(pred >= 0.5,
                      levels = c(FALSE, TRUE))
  )

# Evaluate model performance
class_metrics(
  data = biomarker_sstar_test,
  truth = class,
  estimate = estimate,
  pred,
  event_level = "second"
)

```
